rationale: Create one canonical Dimension Energy distributed-energy platform, retaining Dimension Renewable Energy as its former-name alias. Partners Group acquired control on June 24, 2021 and Dimension confirmed that ownership again on August 17, 2026. FTC Solar is preserved as a former approximately 23% owner that sold its entire interest at closing. Project LLCs, project joint ventures, lenders and tax-equity investors are not separate platform owners.

afterImage.description: Dimension Energy LLC is a U.S. distributed-energy platform that develops, finances, owns and operates community solar, battery storage and localized power infrastructure. The platform serves households, businesses, utilities and large energy users across multiple U.S. markets and reported more than 600 MW operating or under construction, over US$2 billion invested and more than 35,000 subscribers by August 2026. Partners Group acquired control on June 24, 2021 through PG Delta Holdco LLC; FTC Solar sold its entire approximately 23% interest at closing. Dimension Renewable Energy is the former brand, while project LLCs, project joint ventures, lenders and tax-equity vehicles remain within or outside the platform boundary rather than separate PortCos. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
